description: Compare charged and apolar lining chemistry along the cavity axis for PXA conduits versus single-lipid carrier proteins
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
D=pd.read_csv("conduit_axis_profiles.csv"); S=pd.read_csv("conduit_axis_summary.csv")
D["rel"]=D["bin"]/9.0
PXA=["Nvj3 61-463 (PXA + C-term)","Mdm1 PXA+PXC","SNX13 PXA+PXC","SNX19 PXA+PXC"]
CAR=["Sec14 (single-lipid pocket)","Osh4 (single-sterol pocket)","Pry1 (sterol-binding CAP)"]

rows=[]
for nm,g in D.groupby("protein"):
    g=g.dropna(subset=["charged_res"]).sort_values("bin")
    ch=g["charged_res"].values; rel=g["rel"].values
    # distance of the charged peak from the cavity midpoint, in units of half-length
    peak=rel[np.argmax(ch)]
    rows.append(dict(protein=nm, charged_max=ch.max(), charged_median=np.median(ch),
                     peak_offset=abs(peak-0.5)/0.5,
                     peak_over_median=ch.max()/max(0.02,np.median(ch)),
                     apolar_median=g["apolar"].median(), group="PXA conduit" if nm in PXA else "single-lipid carrier"))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values(["group","protein"]); T.to_csv("conduit_headgroup_signature.csv",index=False)
print(T.round(3).to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
for nm,g in D.groupby("protein"):
    g=g.sort_values("bin")
    st=dict(lw=2.4, ls="-") if nm in PXA else dict(lw=1.6, ls="--")
    c="#c0392b" if nm.startswith("Nvj3") else ("#e59866" if nm in PXA else "#2471a3")
    ax[0].plot(g["rel"], g["charged_res"], marker="o", ms=4, color=c, label=nm, **st)
    ax[1].plot(g["rel"], g["apolar"], marker="o", ms=4, color=c, label=nm, **st)
ax[0].set_xlabel("relative position along cavity long axis"); ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction of lining residues that are D/E/K/R/H")
ax[0].set_title("Charged lining residues along the cavity axis")
ax[1].set_xlabel("relative position along cavity long axis"); ax[1].set_ylabel("apolar fraction of lining heavy atoms (C, S)")
ax[1].set_title("Apolar character along the cavity axis")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=7, loc="lower right")
for a_ in ax: a_.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.suptitle("PXA conduits are uniformly apolar end to end; single-lipid carriers carry a charged headgroup end", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
